bio: Product leader at the frontier of AI agents and developer experience. I ship tools that make developers choose your platform—through great DX and by giving AI coding tools superpowers. Before product, I spent a decade as an engineer shipping code at Netflix, Reddit, and LinkedIn, which means I build for developers because I am one. Most recently Staff Product Manager at Databricks, focused on developer infrastructure and AI products. Previously led product at Neon (acquired by Databricks), Snowflake/Streamlit, Stripe, and Microsoft Azure—giving me deep experience across the data and developer tools landscape. I also teach courses on Frontend Masters covering React, databases, Linux, and web development fundamentals—people have watched my content for over 100 person-years. When I'm not thinking about agents and APIs, you can find me snowboarding or following Cagliari Calcio, where I'm a part owner.

name: Aaron Lower
title: Product Manager | Tech Geek
bio: I build the platform products that other products depend on. Over 15 years at Microsoft and Tableau/Salesforce, I've shipped products used by 100M+ users, driven $400M+ in revenue across B2B, SaaS, and cloud platforms, and led the kind of complex, cross organizational work that turns technical infrastructure into business growth. At Tableau, I owned the cloud migration strategy that grew the migration business by $50M, led the team's first major open-source release post Salesforce acquisition unblocking $900M of customer revenue to migrate to Tableau Cloud, and shipped AI powered features including the Show Me recommendation engine and conversational analytics agents. At Microsoft, I spent 14 years building and scaling platform products across Azure, Windows, and developer tools. I stood up customer feedback programs with 1,000+ enterprise stakeholders, shipped Windows recovery technologies deployed to 100M+ devices, and drove Azure platform resiliency capabilities with Fortune 100 customers. I'm looking for my next Senior or Principal PM role focused on platform, AI, or developer experience products. I care about shipping things that matter to real users at real scale. Open to: Seattle based roles (hybrid or remote), platform PM, AI/ML product management, developer tools, B2B SaaS.

bio:
I have more than a decade of developing, designing, and managing software products & open source SDKs. I work across the full product stack, specializing in complex technical areas that require a balance of engineering depth, customer empathy, and complex product requirements at scale. 

Developing next-gen AI capabilities for Teams Platform. Product lead for Microsoft’s Live Share SDK. Authentication expert, specializing in enterprise-grade security models for modern SAAS products. Developer experience obsessed. Regularly spearhead releases of services and features that meet robust privacy, security, and compliance requirements. 

—


See my portfolio at https://www.studiobliss.io for more information. 

Core skills:
- Product management
- Web App Development (React, Next.js, Vue)
- UX Design (Figma, research)
- Landing page design & development
- Artificial intelligence (AI) & large language models (LLM)
- Analytics & Data Analysis (SQL, Scuba, Pendo, Firebase, etc.)
- Open Source
- Authentication (SAML, OpenId Connect, OAuth 2, Enterprise & Consumer federation)

Other Skills
- SQL, MongoDB, CosmosDB
- Web sockets & real-time collaboration architecture
- Native iOS Development (Swift)
- Native Android Development (Kotlin)
- Flutter iOS & Android apps (cross platform)
- Rust
- Golang
- Java
- Unity Development (C#)
- Digital Marketing (AdWords, Facebook/Instagram, Twitter, etc.)

title: Product Designer | Mobile & Web UX, SaaS | Collaborative, Impact-Driven Outcomes 🚀✨
bio: 🧚 Who am I? Berlin-based UX/UI Designer with 3 years of experience specializing in mobile app design and user-centered solutions. My expertise includes designing intuitive user experiences from concept to delivery, and working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges in the digital product design space. Most recently, I contributed to automotive mobile apps (iOS & Android), working closely with product owners, developers, and design teams. 🔥 What drives me? I thrive in collaborative environments, focusing on user-centered design principles to create engaging, efficient, and accessible experiences. My approach is iterative—continuously testing, gathering user feedback, and refining designs to ensure they meet user needs and business goals. 🌟 My approach? Curiosity and pragmatism guide my process. I love to translate user pain points into actionable solutions, whether it's through prototyping, user research, or workshops. I'm constantly learning and evolving as a designer, eager to apply my skills to industries that align with my values. 🚀 What's next? After refining my skills in automotive UX design, I’m eager to apply my expertise in mobile UX/UI design to new industries. With a strong foundation in user-centered design solutions, I’m excited to explore opportunities where I can contribute to creating impactful products that not only empower users but also foster positive change. 🎯 Core skills UX & UI Design, Wireframing & Prototyping, Usability Testing, Interaction Design (IxD), Design Systems Management, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1), Cross-functional Collaboration, Stakeholder Management, Project Management, Workshop Facilitation, Figma, Sketch, Adobe Suite. 🎨 Beyond the screen In my downtime, I enjoy art, nature, analog photography, DJing, and dancing. As a proud cat mom, I balance my creative pursuits with a love for exploring cultures and the world around me. 🌍 Additional Based in Berlin with an EU working permit, I’m open to various work setups, with a preference for remote work. While I’m ideally seeking a full-time remote position, I am also open to exploring freelance opportunities if the right project aligns with my skill set and interests. 💌 I am open to exciting new opportunities! Let's chat about potential collaborations via LinkedIn messages or email.

bio: I am a Senior User Experience Designer and consultant based in Berlin. With over 20 years of professional experience working for small and large companies and agencies, I bring a wealth of experience and expertise to the table. My focus is on the conceptual design for apps and websites, as well as creative copywriting and marketing support. I have a particular interest in DTx/eHealth and enjoy working on projects related to DiGA, DiPA, and medical software. I thrive in team environments and enjoy collaborating with others to bring great ideas to life. So whether you're in Germany or the Nordics, I'm available for remote or hybrid work and always eager to take on new challenges! Let's connect and explore how we can work together – feel free to ask me anything in German or English. Jeg snakker bare litt norsk, men jeg vil gjerne lære språket!

bio: I build production-grade machine learning systems with a focus on LLM-powered NLP applications and decision intelligence tools. At Biogen, I contributed to the deployment of LLM-based summarization and decision analysis pipelines that reduced manual review time and improved turnaround for internal research workflows. Previously at UOB, I worked on large-scale anomaly detection systems processing 10M+ daily API records. My technical focus includes interpretability research, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), generative AI systems, model evaluation, and ML deployment. I am particularly interested in building reliable, explainable LLM systems for high-stakes domains such as finance and research.

bio: At Linksquares I used a wide array of machine learning techniques to extract information from documents. I worked on the full pipeline from training to validation to prediction. I have experience working with Transformers, Computer Vision, and Generative Models (LLMs). I am an expert in data preparation, this includes gathering data with SQL, pre-processing, augmentation, and post-processing. I received my PhD from Tufts University in Physics. I specialized in creating models to predict the behavior of fluid and elastic systems where geometry plays an important role. I also developed Natural Language Processing applications to help organize conference schedules and suggest relevant events at conferences to attendees.

bio: Published author of The Esports Revolution (ISBN 9798696362236) Experienced angel/venture investor who has crossed from one side of the negotiation table as an entrepreneur to the other as an angel. Having angel invested for about 2 to 3 years, Lance is now the Founding Managing Partner of Gamerforce Ventures, an early stage venture capital firm focused on the esports and gaming sector. The fund (Gamerforce I) that is in the midst of raising is targeted at companies between Seed and Series B, with opportunistic investments in later stage companies. Previously, as an entrepreneur, he has built and sold a cloud computing (PAAS) business within 7 years, and has made more than US$1m in investments into startups directly, and indirectly through multiple venture funds. "The highest reward for man's dedication to excellence is not what one gets from it, but what he or she becomes through it." Grateful for the people around me for guiding me along and making me a better person along the way.

name: Paul Fisher
title: CTO / Co-Founder at Vowel
bio:
Previously, I was a Principal Engineer at Zapier, leading the architecture of AI Agents, after Zapier acquired Vowel (where I was the CTO and Co-Founder).

Vowel, was an AI-powered conferencing platform, which pioneered ground-breaking AI features, such as real-time meeting summarization, action-item detection, and native agentic / search capabilities. 

Vowel was acquired by Zapier in 2023. 

Prior to Vowel, I was the CTO at Recombine, a genomics platform and genetic testing company, which was acquired by Cooper Surgical in 2016 for ~ $100M. After the acquisition of Recombine, I was the CTO at Phosphorus, a genomics company founded as part of the Recombine acquisition.

Prior to Recombine, I was the CTO at Onswipe, a mobile/tablet publishing / adtech platform, which was acquired by Beanstock Media.

I was also the CTO at Sonar Media, a pioneer mobile social discovery platform (which was awarded 2nd place at TechCrunch Disrupt in NYC). Sonar was also one the portfolio companies at K2 MediaLabs — where I served as CTO, prior to joining Sonar.

I was also Director of Engineering at LimeWire, a peer-to-peer file-sharing platform, where I oversaw seven engineering teams internationally. 

Prior to LimeWire I managed technology for Wired Digital, a Conde Nast company, where I lead engineering for wired.com and other Wired brands (including webmonkey.com, hotwired.com, and reddit), in San Francisco and New York.

Prior to Wired, I was the co-founder and CTO of SmartPants Media, an award-winning digital media company, where I developed / launched dozens of interactive and educational software products, including interactive kiosks for the Smithsonian, and telephony/streaming applications deployed across government agencies throughout the US.

I have nearly 30 years of experience building and leading engineering and product teams, with a focus on scaling high-traffic, data-intensive AI / ML platforms. 

Having founded, scaled, and sold several start-ups, I have developed deep business, product, and technical expertise, as well as experience recruiting, launching and marketing products, and scaling cpu and gpu infrastructure to support fault-tolerant, low latency use-cases (leveraging technologies such as terraform, kubernetes, docker, helm, mlops). 

I have co-authored three technology books (published by Apress/Springer) and have authored several patents.

name: Andrew Thomas
bio: I've spent my career building technology that scales — from the first line of code to global platforms handling hundreds of millions of users and transactions daily. Most recently, I co-founded and served as CTO of Intelligent Reach for 13 years, growing it from a startup to a 100-person business operating across the UK, USA, Australia and New Zealand, before a successful exit in 2024. Beyond the CTO role, I also founded and ran the APAC operation as MD — building it from nothing to a profitable team of 10 with enterprise clients including Adidas, Samsung, HP and Lenovo. At its peak, the platform tracked ~600 million unique users, managed ~100 million products across 30,000 data channels daily — all on resilient, auto-scaling cloud infrastructure (Azure & AWS) with a 30TB data warehouse growing 50GB a day. Along the way I raised VC funding, built and led engineering teams to 35 developers, launched into new international markets, and drove 30% of revenue from outside our home market. I'm now selectively exploring my next chapter — founder CTO, technical co-founder, or senior technology leadership roles where I can help scale something genuinely ambitious. Particularly interested in electronics/cloud, smart home/IoT, Space and exciting AI enabled SaaS tech platforms. Core strengths: platform architecture at scale, cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS), building high performing teams, engineering leadership, VC fundraising, and taking products from zero to exit.

name: Felix Serrano
title: Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer at Activus Connect, a Tech Mahindra Company | YPO
bio: With a career defined by transformation, scale, and successful exits, I’ve led from both the boardroom and the ground floor—building high-impact businesses, assembling elite leadership teams, and navigating complex global markets. As the Co-Founder and former CEO of Activus Connect, I scaled a remote-first BPM company from concept to acquisition, leading to a strategic exit to Tech Mahindra. My journey has blended corporate command with entrepreneurial agility. I’ve led $250M+ portfolios, built virtual global workforces, self-funded startups, and driven M&A integrations across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC. I’ve sat on both sides of the table—as the operator and the acquirer—giving me a unique lens on how real, sustainable value is built. Today, I’m on sabbatical. After decades of scaling high-growth ventures, I’ve carved out time to reset, reconnect, and remain curious. But the entrepreneurial fire doesn’t fade—I’m always open to bold conversations and future-focused ventures that aim to do things differently. If you’re building something extraordinary and think I can add value—reach out.

Served in CEO, President, COO, CFO, CIO roles for publicly traded, PE-backed, and other privately held businesses. I have been brought in to manage roll-ups, return businesses to profitability, and drive rapid growth across several industries from biotech to telecom to media and entertainment and automotive. I have demonstrated success in M&A with over 10 transactions where I have led the due diligence, integration and alignment with each outperforming the investment thesis. I have contributed meaningfully in multiple exits returning more than $1 billion of investor capital. My passion is building corporate competitive advantage and driving growth in tech-based companies and my experience spans sectors focused on SaaS and recurring revenue businesses (B2B and B2C) as well as durable goods, manufacturing, and distribution. Expertise: Recurring Revenue Businesses, Growth Strategy, GTM, Product Strategy, Business Operations, Operational Excellence, Tech, Distribution, Manufacturing, Product Lifecycle Management, Lean, Team Building, M&A, Integrations, Data Science and Business Intelligence, and Investor Relations.

bio: Tech Founder | SaaS Exit → TOTVS (B3) | SaaS Scale-up & E-Commerce I build at the intersection of product, technology, and capital. From zero to exit and from exit to what's next. Lexos (2009 → TOTVS 2023) — Founded and scaled a SaaS platform that centralized marketplace and e-commerce operations for Brazilian retailers — 2,000+ active clients, ~R$2B in annual GMV, acquired by TOTVS (B3: TOTS3) in 2023. Full GTM cycles, enterprise sales, and ecosystem partnerships with Brazil's largest marketplaces: Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magazine Luiza and TikTok Shop. Officially homologated by all five platforms — including partner recognition awards (Amazon Conecta). Inside TOTVS (2023–2025) — Stayed on as Statutory Director. Led a 100+ person team across product, engineering, sales, and CS. Built nationwide commercial expansion across regional offices, trained sales teams, and managed C-level partnerships across Brazil's digital ecosystem. Post-exit — Advisor and angel investor working directly with founders on GTM strategy, governance, fundraising, and liquidity events. Embedded in the Brazilian tech and VC ecosystem. Regular columnist at E-Commerce Brasil and speaker at RD Summit 2025. Donnah AI — Building a post-meeting execution platform. Decisions made in meetings actually happen, turning conversations into action through AI, WhatsApp and CRM integrations My edge: I've sat on both sides of the table — as the founder being backed and as the executive scaling inside a public company. I understand what it takes to grow from zero and what it takes to operate at scale. Marathon runner. Ironman triathlete. High performance is a lifestyle, not a campaign.

name: Donald Haché
title: CEO & Chief Strategic Advisor to Scaling High-Growth Ventures | M&A Strategy Expert | Growth to Exit Mastermind 👉Scale, Grow, Acquire and Exit on your terms!
bio: Many founder-led companies reach a point where growth begins to feel harder than it should. Revenue increases. The team grows. The opportunity remains. Yet decisions slow, leadership waits for direction, and the organization becomes more not less dependent on the founder. This is rarely a motivation problem. It is an architecture problem. Enterprise value is not an outcome. It is designed. Most founder-led companies don’t stall because of markets. They stall because the business eventually outgrows the founder operating model. Revenue scales. Complexity multiplies. Yet leadership systems, decision flow, operational structure, governance, and capital alignment often remain founder-dependent, quietly compressing growth, execution, and enterprise value. That’s the work I’ve spent the last 30 years inside. I work with founder-led companies, ownership groups, and investors when growth begins to outpace the existing operating model, helping redesign the leadership and operational architecture required to scale, attract capital, increase enterprise value, and operate beyond founder dependency. The work integrates: • strategy • leadership systems • AI leverage • execution discipline • governance • capital alignment into one scalable enterprise architecture. Over three decades across industrial automation, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, energy and professional services, I’ve contributed to more than $2B in M&A transactions and worked alongside 150+ leadership teams across Canada and the United States. Most buyers don’t buy businesses. They buy leadership systems. Donald (Don) Haché Founder of Selltron Group and 10X Strategy. Knowledge is now abundant. Time is scarce. 📅 tidycal.com/donhache

bio: As a Research Engineer at Tsinghua Information Science And Technology National Laboratory, I lead a team of four to build and deploy an automated guided vehicle (AGV) for navigation in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal 3, achieving a centimeter-level precision in a large indoor space. I use a deep neural network (DNN) as the backbone algorithm to detect the floor tile gaps and calibrate the odometer during indoor localization, reducing the memory usage from GB to MB compared to traditional SLAM-based methods. I am also a dual-degree Master's student of Technology Innovation at the University of Washington and Tsinghua University, with a primary background in computer science. I have skills and experience in software development, machine learning, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and human-computer interaction. I have completed multiple projects and courses in these domains, such as an AI scheduler based on reinforcement learning, a plugin app for online meeting microphone switches, and two Coursera certifications in supervised machine learning and deep neural networks. I am passionate about applying my knowledge and skills to solve real-world problems and create innovative solutions. I am also pursuing a fintech background and preparing for CFA. I am eager to learn new technologies and collaborate with diverse and talented teams.

I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies, and to share my knowledge and expertise with my team and the online marketing community.

name: Tobenna Abanofor
title: Senior Backend Engineer at Deel
bio: Technology for me, has always been a language of creativity — a way to turn imagination into something tangible, functional, and lasting. Over the past 7+ years, I’ve built systems professionally that don’t just scale, but empower people and businesses to do more with confidence and efficiency. I’ve worked across fintech, HR tech, and IoT — from architecting resilient event-driven infrastructures at AiCare, to leading backend design and integrations at Interlnkd and now Deel, where I help shape tools that support employee learning and performance on a global scale. I’m currently building Yoyo, an extensible IoT communication platform written in Go, designed to connect devices through gRPC, MQTT, and HTTP. Yoyo is built to be modular — allowing developers to extend communication protocols and create event-driven, data-rich systems that bridge the gap between devices and computation. I love solving complex problems, designing elegant architectures, and mentoring others who are equally passionate about technology and its potential to create impact. As a member of NaiBAN, I also collaborate with other investors and builders to support early-stage founders shaping Africa’s next wave of innovation. Always open to connecting with fellow engineers, founders, and teams working on scalable, high-impact technology.

name: Tung Nguyen
title: System Software and Backend Developer
bio:
I am a Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience in all levels of software development and system design. As a tech enthusiast, I have extensive experience in developing low-level, complex, high-performance, and low-latency systems. I possess strong knowledge of C/C++ (std11, std14), Linux, Golang, Java, Python, OOP, socket programming, I/O operations, and multi-threading. I have a passion for Linux.
I have long-time experience working for various tech startups as a Full-Stack Developer and System Designer. I have completed numerous projects in web, mobile, and data engineering, making me proficient with modern frameworks such as Gin-Gonic, Spring Boot, Dropwizard, Flask, ExpressJS, ReactJS, and Next.js. I am also experienced with various databases, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Cassandra. I love database design and optimization for high performance and data consistency.
With many years of experience as a System Designer and DevOps Engineer, I am well-versed in Cloud, Hybrid, and on-premise server development and management. I am familiar with AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Security, DNS, SSL, and cryptography.
I've got a bachelor's degree in Computer Science so I have a good background in Data Structure and Algorithm, Machine Learning, AI...

My experience spans backend engineering with Go and Python, distributed systems architecture, and platform engineering, alongside full-stack development using TypeScript, Vue.js, and React. I enjoy working across the entire engineering stack—from designing system architecture and cloud infrastructure to implementing APIs and user-facing applications. I have worked extensively with cloud platforms such as GCP and Azure, building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, containerized services with Docker, and infrastructure automation using Terraform. My focus is on designing systems that are observable, resilient, and capable of scaling in production environments. Key areas of expertise include: • Distributed systems design and backend architecture • Backend engineering with Go and Python • Cloud-native infrastructure (GCP, Azure) • Platform engineering and developer tooling • CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes • Full-stack development with TypeScript, Vue.js, and React I am particularly interested in engineering roles focused on backend systems, platform engineering, and scalable infrastructure where system design, reliability, and performance are core priorities.

name: Bas Jorissen
title: Founder & Partner @ Archipel Tax Advice | Dutch FT 50 under 35 [Class of 2025] | Bridging the Tax Policy Gap for Startups & Innovation
bio: Hi there, pleasure having you on my profile! Who am I? Bas Jorissen, founder at Archipel Tax Advice and a Tax Advisor mainly to Startup & Scaleup companies, teams and Founders that combine high growth and innovation with a desire to do some good and share the pie. With more than a decade of experience in this niche neck of the woods, I am proud to now advise to game changing clients as well as policy makers who push for better Startup & Innovation ecosystems. Why do I love what I do? I am a political junkie, I like to think I have some instincts for macro and micro-economic reasoning, and I enjoy the 'legal work' that is building a case. Tax Law is an organic combination, and I enjoy following how new legislation is conceived, understanding what goals it aims to achieve, envisaging how it seeks to do so in an individual case, arguing if it should apply and quarterbacking how it interacts with a broader business strategy. What about me personally? Proud dad to two girls, mom is my Leiden University sweetheart. We have two dogs, Frank and Dieter. They come to the office with me. We live in The Hague, which is also where I was born and where I largely grew up. But I also spent time abroad; lived in the United States with the family for 3 years as a teen. That was fun and formative. Love the US still. Am a proud European though. Big brother in a family of four. We are tight and our 'sunday roasts' remain consistent and non negotiable. Dutch-Indonesian descent plays a role there; that cuisine is bomb. I love rugby, but only play the touch version; I am somewhat quick, not at all big. I love cafes and not clubs. I play the drums. Love music and always have it on at the office. Prefer any song with a shuffle feel. Love politics. Vote Party for the Animals. Because I find them green yet pro-business. And I love the outdoors as well as doing business. Hence the dogs. And Archipel. Cheers!

bio: I am Daniël Meeusen, tax advisor and founder of Meeusen Tax Advice. With a background in Tax Law and Economics from Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences and experience in the Dutch tax advisory sector since 2021, I bring a wealth of knowledge to my clients. In 2023, I founded my own firm to provide personalized tax and accounting services with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and financial clarity. My mission is to ensure my clients never miss deductions or incur unnecessary penalties. I support both entrepreneurs and individuals, helping them stay on top of their financials and plan effectively for the future. I’m particularly energized by working with startups, whose creativity and enthusiasm inspire me, and I value the efficiency and insight that come from collaborating with experienced business owners. Through my expertise, I have helped many clients avoid penalties and achieve financial stability. My goal is to relieve them of financial burdens so they can focus on what truly matters. Financial well-being is within everyone’s reach, and I’m here to make that a reality.

Steuerberater / Certified Tax Advisor

bio: Steuerberater mit umfassender Expertise in der Unternehmensbesteuerung, Umstrukturierungen und Bewertungen – ich begleite Startups, Scaleups und deren Investoren durch alle Phasen unternehmerischer Entwicklung und Transformation. Mein Ziel: steuerliche Klarheit und wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen für wachstumsstarke Unternehmen. Unternehmensbesteuerung: Beratung zu komplexen nationalen und internationalen Steuerfragen mit Fokus auf skalierbare Strukturen, die nachhaltiges Wachstum und Investorenfähigkeit unterstützen. Umstrukturierungen: Begleitung von Reorganisationen, Verschmelzungen und Abspaltungen – mit Blick auf rechtliche Machbarkeit, steuerliche Effizienz und strategische Zielsetzung. Bewertungen & §19a EStG: Praxisnahe Erfahrung in Unternehmensbewertungen zu steuerlichen Zwecken, insbesondere im Kontext von Mitarbeiterbeteiligungen und startup-spezifischen Instrumenten. Steuerliche Deklaration & Compliance: Ganzheitliche Unterstützung bei Steuererklärungen und laufender steuerlicher Pflichterfüllung – rechtssicher, aktuell und risikominimierend. Arbeitsweise: Ich verbinde steuerliche Präzision mit unternehmerischem Denken. Ob es um die Optimierung einer Beteiligungsstruktur, die Lösung grenzüberschreitender Steuerfragen oder die Vorbereitung auf eine Finanzierungsrunde geht – ich arbeite eng mit Gründer:innen, CFOs und Legal-Teams zusammen, um Lösungen zu schaffen, die rechtlich Bestand haben und strategisch wirken. -- Tax advisor with deep expertise in corporate taxation, restructurings, and valuations — supporting startups, scaleups, and their investors through all stages of growth and change. I help clients navigate the German tax landscape with clarity, confidence, and commercial focus. Corporate Tax: Advising on complex domestic and international tax matters with scalable, investor-ready structures. Restructurings: Supporting mergers, spin-offs, and reorganizations with a focus on tax efficiency and strategic fit. Valuations & §19a EStG: Experienced in tax valuations for employee incentive plans and startup equity instruments. Tax Compliance: Full-service support for filings, declarations, and reporting — precise, risk-aware, and aligned with current rules. Approach: I combine technical tax knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset — working closely with founders, CFOs, and legal teams to design tax solutions that stand up to scrutiny and drive execution.

bio:
Forbes Top 100 Accounting Firms in Italy | Chartered Accountant (Italy & UK) | International & Domestic Tax Expert | Corporate Governance & VAT Specialist

📌 I believe that taxation should not be a barrier but a strategic opportunity for businesses and professionals. In a complex regulatory environment like Italy, having a trusted advisor to guide you through tax management, compliance, and business development makes all the difference.
My goal is to help sole trader, companies, CEOs, expats, and investors navigate the Italian tax and regulatory system with confidence, ensuring efficiency, optimization, and sustainable growth.

📌I combine deep expertise with a strategic vision to offer tailored solutions. With my dual qualification in Italy and the UK, I support both companies entering the Italian market and those already operating in Italy, helping them optimize their tax and governance structures.

📊 How can I support you?
✔ Are you an international company entering Italy? I help you set up a tax-efficient and compliant business structure.
✔ Are you an expat or investor? I optimize your tax position to ensure you maximize available benefits.
✔ Already operating in Italy? I assist with tax compliance, accounting, and business growth strategies.
✔ Starting a new business? I provide guidance on company formation and tax planning for startups and SMEs.

📌 WHAT – What I Do
🔹 International Tax & Expat Tax Planning
- Tax optimization for businesses and professionals operating between Italy, the UK, and Europe
- Tax planning for expats, freelancers, and High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWI)
- Advice on tax residency, impatriate tax regime, and other fiscal incentives

🔹 Tax Compliance & Advisory for Italian Businesses
- Tax and accounting consulting for companies and self-employed professionals
- Tax calculations, returns, and optimization strategies
- Compliance with Italian tax obligations (VAT, IRES, IRAP, IRPEF, 770) and UK ax obligations

🔹 Company Formation & Business Development
- Business setup (SRL, SPA, partnerships, sole proprietorships)
- Guidance on choosing the best corporate structure for your needs
- Support for startups and growing businesses

🔹 Corporate Governance & VAT Compliance
- Strategic consulting on corporate structures and governance
- VAT management and compliance for national and cross-border operations
- Tax filings and registrations for Italian and international businesses

📩 Looking to optimize your tax strategy or expand your business? Let’s connect!

bio: Have you ever thought about how strategic tax planning could significantly boost your profitability? At GTL Consulting, we turn tax from a burden into a business advantage. Many businesses face challenges like: 1. Unplanned taxes disrupting their business. 2. Shelving plans because of perceived tax burdens. 3. Financial losses due to poor tax management. Does this sound familiar? Last-minute tax issues can be stressful and expensive, damaging your reputation and relationships with banks and clients. It's frustrating for us as a firm to see people managing their business effortlessly without considering tax issues, unaware of their tax risks, and then falling into major problems and battling penalties and laws. Now, imagine having a tax consultant who truly understands your business and helps you plan transactions strategically. Imagine a future where your tax strategy supports sustainable growth and compliance. At GTL Consulting, we offer: - In-depth tax compliance reviews - Proactive tax optimization - Long-term strategic tax planning We become your in-house tax partners, providing ongoing support! Ready to optimize your tax strategy? Send me a message to learn how GTL Consulting can assist you. For more details, visit our website.

name: Sander Crombach
title: Freelance senior UX & UI Designer, Product Designer and Design Lead (currently Booking.com) | Co-founder of Fluently (fluently.so) | Designing user-centric digital products that people love and trust
bio: → www.sandercromba.ch → hi@sandercromba.ch One of the earliest lessons I learned was at Vodafone and Zalando. Working across international teams in London and Berlin taught me how to collaborate across cultures, align diverse perspectives, and operate effectively in complex organizations. It shaped how I communicate, lead, and build trust at scale. In my opinion, design only succeeds when it delivers measurable outcomes. At EVBox, restructuring the core funnel led to a 15% increase in sales, reinforcing how directly design decisions influence business results. Years later, at Booking.com, I learned the discipline of experimentation and testing at extreme scale. We tested cross platform features with tens of millions of daily visitors. Within minutes, hundreds of thousands of users were using a new hypothesis, providing immediate feedback and clear signals to iterate or move on. That way of working fundamentally changed how I approach product design. At SiriusXM, I led and empowered design teams responsible for products used by millions. From presenting to the CEO and 80+ senior leaders to guiding teams through complex decisions, my focus was on connecting design to strategic direction. As Design Lead on a large scale website redesign serving more than 140 million annual visitors, this work delivered a 4.3% lift in conversion. —- Risk-free & compliant (B.V. + studio): I operate through my own Dutch B.V. and working from my own studio location, with independent hardware and licenses, offering you the agility of a freelancer with the reliability and compliance of an external vendor. No HR headaches, just high-quality design and strategy delivered on time. I work best with startups, scaleups, or innovation teams, leading design principles and strategies to transform complex ideas into intuitive, scalable solutions that deliver meaningful value to both users and businesses. I’ve worked across sectors - from urban planning tools to logistics systems and community platforms -always focusing on creating real, measurable impact. One highlight was designing the first product for a logistics company, helping them secure €450,000 in their first investment round - a clear example of how design-led strategy drives business success. I’m known as a no-nonsense organizer who thrives on simplifying complexity and setting up practical frameworks that actually work. By blending UX best practices, hands-on leadership and the latest tools and tech, I help teams deliver smarter, faster, and more effective solutions.

bio: I'm a Product Designer with over 5 years of experience, specializing in solving complex design problems for B2B software that involves many connected parts (SaaS/multi-system). My main skill is using a 'big picture' approach (systems and architectural thinking) to turn business goals and product needs into working digital products. I make complicated projects easy to understand by showing how different parts connect and depend on each other, using simple diagrams to keep all teams aligned. Ultimately, I design solutions that are not only user-focused and deliver true value, but are also viable from technical and business perspectives. Some of my recent impacts include: - Driving Growth: Redesigned core features at SurveyMonkey that led to a 35% increase in feature usage and improved upgrade intent. - Scaling Products: Expanded product offerings by designing a new Add-on Marketplace and bank integrations for Visma Nmbrs. - Improving Efficiency: Co-managed design systems that reduced rework and accelerated delivery across multiple product squads. Early in my career, I worked as an Innovation Consultant, where I used Design Thinking and Agile methodologies to accelerate corporate innovation across various sectors (healthcare, pharma, consumer goods). This experience provided a crucial foundation in business viability and design strategy.

bio: As a Product Designer at Surfly, I contribute to the design system that improves accessibility, consistency, and performance of the collaboration tool. I also lead the redesign of the platform's session feature, resulting in a 40% reduction in user churn and a 5% increase in DAUs weekly. With over 4 years of experience in both B2B and B2C domains, I have a strong foundation in design thinking and user-centered design. I possess a keen eye for detail and a passion for crafting intuitive and visually appealing experiences, using tools such as Sketch, Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite. I am well-versed in conducting user research, creating wireframes and prototypes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. I foster effective communication and coordination between stakeholders, developers, and product managers, ensuring the alignment of business goals and user needs. I have worked across diverse industries, including e-commerce and fintech, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities that each domain presents. I thrive in dynamic and fast-paced environments, where I can continuously learn and grow. I am looking for new opportunities to leverage my skills and experience to drive impactful and innovative solutions.

name: Nancy Sihmar
title: Product Designer | Human Computer Interaction Design Master's | ex- SAP Labs (4+ years)
bio:
Hey I’m Nancy, a Digital Product Designer. With a background in UX Design, UX Research, Front-end Development, Service Design and a smidgen of Product Management - I strive to design end-to-end experiences for humans. Sometimes that means creating new web or mobile tools and other times it means enabling collaboration and communication channels between people.

💥 Currently, I'm at the design helm, sculpting a No-Code Editor & Process Management SaaS Platform tailored towards medium-to-large enterprise customers. In this very moment, I'm carefully running concept tests with users and laying a sturdy foundation of a new House Design System.

💰 My journey includes a stint at SAP Labs R&D, where I orchestrated the delivery of features impacting over 60 million user accounts. I spearheaded a 0-1 initiative that not only added substantial revenue to the coffers (€1M+) but also empowered customers to seamlessly exchange (and later sell) curated data analytics reports without leaving the platform.

📊 As the sole UX Designer for a responsive web application, I orchestrated a 30% acceleration in the resolution of customer incidents, streamlined workflows for 70+ employees spanning 5+ support and development teams, resulting in a noteworthy €500k in cost savings for the business.

🎓 In 2022, I earned my Master's in Human-Computer Interaction Design from the Netherlands. Equipped with insights into human behavioural and psychological patterns, I designed digital and tangible experiences for esteemed customers such as Erasmus+, Jumbo Supermarket, and MTN. I spent a transformative semester at Aalto University in Finland, practicing Service Design under the mentorship of visionary Founders and Senior Service Designers at Futurice.

bio: As a research associate at Corteva Agriscience, I contribute to the development and improvement of high-quality seeds for various crops. I am involved in inbred management, inventory management, team management, phenotyping, trial planting and management, and data analysis and publishing. I use precision planter and modern technologies to ensure optimal results. I graduated with a bachelor's degree in agronomy and crop science from the University of Zululand in 2016. I am passionate about crop production and soil conservation, and I have gained valuable experience as an intern at the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development, where I assisted senior supervisors on a community development project. I have also participated in farmers day events and learned about new hybrids and fertilizers. My goal is to apply my skills and knowledge to enhance food security and sustainability.

name: Edrick Bwambale
title: Crop Scientist | 2023 Laureate of UN's SDG 1: No Poverty Award | Systems Thinker
bio: My main objective is to empower smallholder farmers and build sustainable food systems for lasting impact. With over eight years of experience, I have managed open-field and greenhouse crops, worked in agro-forestry, developed agribusinesses, collected and analyzed research data, and led projects. I founded the Sustainable Agri-Food Initiative (www.safi-ug.org) in 2021, leveraging my experience to design innovative climate-resilient cropping systems, pioneer affordable post-harvest solutions, and deliver hands-on training for farmers in remote areas. Through cross-sector partnerships, I spearhead projects by tailoring interventions to local needs, directly advancing food security and agribusiness in underserved communities. My work creates jobs by training rural youth in sustainable agri-food production, directly supporting inclusive economic growth. In August 2023, the Sustainable Agri-Food Initiative (SAFI) received international recognition when I earned the UN's SDG 1: No Poverty Award at the 5th African Youth SDGs Summit in Lusaka, Zambia.

name: Palesa Motaung
title: Agricultural Soil Scientist | Harvesting Africa's Agricultural Potential with Science, Business and Innovative Soil Solutions
location: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
bio: I’m Palesa Motaung, a dedicated professional with over 10 years of experience in the Agriculture and Research sectors. My passion lies in advancing sustainable food production and fostering innovative business solutions to transform Africa’s agricultural landscape. As the Founder of Bread, a Research & Development organization based in Johannesburg, South Africa, I lead efforts to support farmers and agri-enterprises in building sustainable and resilient businesses. Through Bread, we provide critical production and business administration support leveraging my knowledge of agriculture and expertise in science & research to address the unique challenges faced by African agriculture. My goal is to support as many farmers and agribusinesses as possible as our industry is Africa's biggest and best employer. I’m based in Johannesburg, where I was born and raised. Outside of work, I enjoy staying active, exploring nature and the game of Chess. I speak Sesotho, isiZulu and English. I'm also learning Kiswahili. I’m eager to collaborate and exchange ideas with like-minded individuals. Connect with me to discuss agriculture, sustainability, or potential partnerships. Let’s work together to shape Africa’s future.

name: Boniphace Nkombe
title: Future of Farming Pioneer | Social Impact Leader | Resilient Food Systems Architect |Cross-Sector Collaboration Champion| Nature Enthusiast
bio: I’m an agri-food systems leader and R&D project manager with a multidisciplinary background in both crop and livestock systems. With academic training in Horticulture and Crop Science (MSc) and Range Management (BSc), I bring a systems-thinking approach to building regenerative, climate-smart, and inclusive solutions for food and land use across Tanzania and sub-Saharan Africa. In my current role as a Senior Agronomist at OCP Africa Tanzania Country Office, I contribute to advancing soil health and supporting the development of locally adapted, crop- and soil-specific agronomic solutions—bridging scientific insight with practical application in diverse farming systems. My work focuses on supporting farmers across different systems—including smallholder and commercial farmers, pastoralists, and rural producers—with practices that restore soil health, revitalize rangelands, conserve biodiversity, and produce nutrient-dense food. I advocate for integrated solutions that balance productivity, environmental sustainability, and long-term resilience. Through cross-sector collaboration, I design and implement strategies that address both environmental and socio-economic challenges—shaping the future of farming toward equity, sustainability, and food security. Above all, I’m committed to co-creating food systems that work—for people, land, and future generations.

title: Senior Scientist at CABI | Plant Health | Food Security | Gender-Inclusive Agricultural Advisory Services
bio: I am an international development professional with over 15 years of experience designing, securing, and leading agricultural development programmes across Africa. My work sits at the intersection of agricultural systems transformation, food security, climate resilience, plant health systems, and institutional strengthening. Throughout my career, I have mobilized and managed more than €7.6 million in donor-funded investments, supported programmes across 13 African countries, and worked with governments, donors, research institutions, NGOs, private-sector partners, and farmer organizations to strengthen agricultural systems and improve rural livelihoods. My leadership has contributed to the establishment and strengthening of more than 500 plant clinics, training of over 1,000 extension personnel and plant health practitioners, and delivery of advisory and plant health services benefiting over 700,000 smallholder farmers. I am particularly passionate about translating scientific evidence into scalable development solutions that strengthen institutions, empower communities, and improve food system resilience. My experience spans programme leadership, resource mobilization, partnership development, governance, knowledge management, agricultural advisory services, integrated pest management, and capacity strengthening. In addition to programme leadership, I contribute to organizational governance through service as Chair of the CABI Africa Procurement Committee, Member of the CABI Ethics Review Board, and Secretary of the PlantwisePlus Burundi Project Board. My research and professional interests include: • Agricultural systems transformation • Food security and climate resilience • Plant health systems strengthening • Agricultural advisory services • Integrated pest management • Digital agriculture and knowledge systems • Institutional capacity development • Gender, inclusion and rural livelihoods • Sustainable food systems I am always interested in connecting with professionals, organizations, and partners working to strengthen resilient, inclusive, and sustainable agricultural systems.

name: Papias Binagwa
title: CIMMYT Adjunct Scientist - Dryland Crops Improvement Program
bio: Worked in the agricultural sector for more than 12 years both in public and private organizations and collaborated with various national and international organizations. Currently, I am serving as a country lead scientist in Tanzania and Senior Agricultural Research Officer under Tanzania Agricultural Research Institute (TARI) focusing generating and promote application of knowledge, innovation and agricultural technologies as catalyst of change in achieving agricultural productivity, food and nutrition security, sustainable agriculture and economic growth involving stakeholders in the country and global community. Also, I am managing various collaborative research projects with other international organizations such as International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT), CIMMYT and International Institute of Tropical Agriculture (IITA) in different projects supported by Gates Foundations and NORAD. Among my responsibilities include project coordination’s and management, staff need assessment on capacity building with great internal working relationships, public-private coordination, national and international organization linkages and country representation globally. Collaboratively, these projects contributed to food security and nutrition amongst vulnerable groups and strengthened community-based organizations and increase smallholder farmers agricultural and financial capacities for market engagement and resilient livelihoods through beans, maize and Mungbean crop value chains in Tanzania.

name: Sarah Bonvoisin
title: Directrice Artistique et Chargée de Booking d'Artistes | Passionnée par la Musique électronique
bio: À partir de la rentrée prochaine, j'apporterai mon expertise et ma passion pour la musique électronique et les arts au cœur de Paris. En tant que Directrice Artistique de la programmation dans un bar audiophile, mais aussi Chargée de booking artistes dans une agence de musiques électroniques, je mettrai mon dynamisme et ma créativité au service de projets artistiques ambitieux. J’orchestrerai la programmation artistique. Ma mission sera de dénicher des talents, de programmer des artistes, de gérer le planning et la programmation du lieu, et de superviser les résidences artistiques. Je m'assurerai que chaque événement reflète l'âme et la diversité culturelle que le lieu souhaite promouvoir. Parallèlement, je serai au cœur de l’action en tant que Chargée de booking. Mes responsabilités incluront la recherche et la négociation des cachets artistiques, la sélection des dates d'événements, ainsi que la gestion des relations avec les promoteurs. Je veillerai également à soutenir et à assurer le suivi des artistes, les accompagnant avec soin et attention dans leur parcours professionnel. Avec cette double casquette, je souhaite faire rayonner chaque artiste et chaque événement, insufflant à chaque projet mon énergie débordante et ma passion inébranlable pour la musique électronique. Que ce soit en programmant des talents prometteurs ou en négociant les meilleures opportunités pour les artistes, je m'efforce de créer des expériences inoubliables et de contribuer activement à la scène culturelle parisienne. ----------------------- 💌 Je rédige régulièrement des articles sur la scène musicale et sur ceux qui la font vivre. Vraie passionnée de Digue, je participe à de nombreux festivals, toujours à la recherche de pépites sonores. Je cherche des expériences dans le domaine de l'événementiel musical : chargée de production ou chargée événementiel, rédactrice de contenu évènementiel où je dispose déjà d'une bonne expérience théorique et pratique. 🙌 Je ne me cantonne pas uniquement sur un secteur d'activités. Je recherche activement de nouvelles opportunités afin de donner un nouvel élan à ma carrière "polymorphe": disquaire, radio, label, médias..--

name: Philippe Barthélémy
bio: Directeur créatif et chef de projet culturel, je développe des plateformes et des narrations autour des scènes musicales électroniques et culturelles émergentes. Je pilote Couvre x Chefs, un projet multidisciplinaire combinant label musical, média éditorial, programmation radio et événementiel. Mon travail se situe à l’intersection de la direction artistique, du développement d’artistes, de la création de contenu et de l’expérience live. J’explore la manière dont les projets culturels peuvent créer des écosystèmes créatifs : relier artistes, publics, médias et espaces physiques à travers des formats hybrides (musique, éditorial, radio, live). Mon approche mêle storytelling culturel, curation artistique et stratégie créative, avec un intérêt particulier pour les scènes émergentes, les cultures alternatives et les nouveaux formats de diffusion. Ouvert aux collaborations, résidences, projets curatoriaux, labels, médias, festivals et plateformes culturelles.

name: Jessica Dumy
bio:
🎧 As of today, I have the honor of working as a DJ agent at CUMAC BOOKING, an agency active on the international electronic music scene.

My role:
Supporting talented artists, organizing their tours, and building strong connections between clubs, festivals, and the music community.

I have a diverse background : before joining CUMAC, I spent several years immersed in the electronic music world, a passion that’s driven me since day one.
I’ve worked as a stage manager, artist liaison, promoter, event organizer, DJ… I’ve touched nearly every corner of the industry.

🎪 I’ve also had the opportunity to collaborate with renowned parties such as Paradise, Elrow, Metamorphosi, and Solid Grooves.

🎶 As a DJ and music producer myself, I maintain a strong connection to the dancefloor. This dual perspective ,both artistic and operational , fuels my work as an agent with a human, dedicated, and sensitive approach.

📩 Feel free to reach out if you’d like to connect or learn more.

bio: Wie ben ik? Ik ben een gestructureerde en proactieve werkorganisator, kan me overal makkelijk aanpassen, ben een kei in notuleren en kan plannen en organiseren. Ik ben accuraat, dienstverlenend, zeer stressbestendig, representatief, altijd vriendelijk, vrolijk, goedgehumeurd, leergierig (ik wil mijzelf continu blijven ontwikkelen, bovendien pak ik zaken snel op!), stabiel, ontzorg graag mensen, geordend en kan ik zowel alleen als in teamverband werken. Ik breng rust in een organisatie. Mijn motto is ' Een dag niet gelachen, is een dag niet geleefd!' Wat kan ik? Ik notuleer graag! Hierdoor ben ik van veel zaken op de hoogte en kan ik daardoor mijn werk beter doen. Ik vind het prettig om onder druk te werken. Hoe drukker, hoe beter! Ook kan ik plannen en organiseren, m.n. het beheren van agenda's en mailboxen, en krijg ik veel zaken geregeld d.m.v. de diverse contacten die ik heb en mijn vriendelijkheid. Wat wil ik? Een soortgelijke functie voor 24 uur, omdat ik een hele goede managementondersteuner / managementassistente / secretaresse ben en mij hierin als een vis in het water voel.

bio: I’m a full-stack web developer with hands-on experience in the PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) and a graduate of Fullstack Academy’s immersive software engineering program. I bring fresh technical training combined with 16 years of professional project leadership, including experience as a senior project manager leading multimillion-dollar developments. That background sharpened my systems thinking, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, which I now apply to building secure, scalable, and user-focused applications. Recent work includes implementing role-based access control (RBAC), secure authentication with JWT/bcrypt, RESTful APIs, PostgreSQL workflows, and AI-assisted utilities. I thrive at the intersection of design and systems. My passion is solving complex problems with creative technology — whether that’s building responsive UIs in React, optimizing back-end APIs, or integrating AI-powered workflows to make apps more effective and engaging.

name: Abhinav Goswami
title: Venture Capital | Private Equity| Technology |Investing | Partnerships | Financial Management |
bio:
Abhinav is a seasoned professional with over 15 years of global experience in Technology, Venture Capital, Fund Raising, and Corporate Development. His expertise spans working with startups/scaleups and mature organizations across the Asia Pacific and North America.

Currently, Abhinav holds the position of Sr Director in Singapore at Daiwa Principal Investment, a leading investor from Japan in Southeast Asia boasting over $4 billion in assets under management. In this role, he oversees the company's investment initiatives.

Abhinav is also sought after for his advisory role with numerous growth-stage companies, where he provides guidance on capital raising and strategic planning. His in-depth knowledge and experience have made him a key player in the investment landscape.

Prior to his current role, Abhinav served as Vice President of Investment at SBI (Softbank) Holdings in Singapore, leading the venture capital team specializing in Fintech and Technology investments. His contributions were instrumental in investing in 25+ companies across Asia, resulting in more than 7 successful exits.

Earlier in his career, Abhinav led the Investment and Global Business Development at Deskera, shaping the company's long-term strategy, partnerships, and fundraising efforts totaling over S$150 million.

As the Chief Corporate Development Officer of Homage, Southeast Asia's Leading Tech-Enabled Caregiving and Health Services Platform, Abhinav played a pivotal role in overseeing finance, investment, corporate growth strategy, M&A evaluations, and leading efforts in capital raising, exceeding S$60 million.Abhinav has a Master's in Finance from London Business School, an MBA from the National University of Singapore (NUS), and an Engineering degree in Computer Science from National Institute of Technology, India.

name: Gail Wong
title: Gender-lens Investor | Certified Coach & Financial Healer | Coralus Activator | Restoring the Feminine in Finance.
bio: I care most about building a sustainable and equitable world for all. I’ve created opportunities for women in corporates, NGOs and entrepreneurship from day 1. I am constantly appreciating new intersectional barriers overdue for dismantling. Parenting a type-A girl and neuro-divergent boy bolsters my lifelong advocacy for the marginalised. “Money flowing to what matters, money as medicine.” Such a systems change requires a reconnection of money to our humanity and spirituality. Facilitating this awakening is my work: a coach and financial healer to individuals, a conscious investor, and advisor to regenerative capital allocators. I did not anticipate this career path when I graduated from Wharton Business School and joined Morgan Stanley. I advised financial services and technology firms in USA, UK and Southeast Asia on >$10Bn of M&A and capital-raises, and was promoted twice in a recession. I coached my first purposeful leader in 2010 and founded my independent practice, Live True, in 2016. I guide my coachees to integrate money with what matters to them as human beings. With me, they begin investing; upgrade their careers; negotiate unemployment or business separations; recover from burnout; fundraise for their business; and navigate other high-stakes life decisions… while honouring their experience and values. Trained in multiple coaching disciplines, my approach is both practical and trauma-informed. I bring compassion and safety to difficult conversations, which sparks profound healing and powerful insight. I have a knack for reading both financial statements/ Excel and the unspoken stirrings of one’s inner world. My lived experience - purpose-seeking corporate escapee; whole-brained yogi; musician; painter; depression survivor; recovering perfectionist, over-worker and people-pleaser - expand capacity to hold space. With my support, my clients take transformative actions that create breakthroughs and sustained behaviour change, building rich lives they love and elevating their self-leadership. As a gender-lens investor in Southeast Asia, I have led angel syndicates and founded a venture capital firm investing in diverse founders. My portfolio is >75% women-led and/or impact-driven, which reflects a thesis of decolonised and reimagined capitalism. I prioritise investment in ventures that heal systemic injustices, build a sustainable and equitable world and return in multiple dimensions. I am proud to advise and champion Angels of Impact, Circulate Capital and Coralus (fka SheEO), organisations that live by the principles of their work.

title: Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia India & SEA)  |  Strategic Development & Strategy
bio:
Di Kun is the Head of Capital Formation at Peak XV Partners, where he leads LP engagement and initiatives to build Peak XV Partners as an institution. Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia) is a leading venture capital and growth investment firm focused on India, Southeast Asia and beyond. 

He joined Peak XV in 2018 as a Director in the Strategic Development team, where he worked closely with portfolio companies on fundraising, M&A and IPO, as well as managing exits. Prior to Peak XV, he spent over a decade in investment banking and consulting roles, advising tech, media & telecom companies/investors on strategic transactions across Asia Pacific.

Proud father of three lovely daughters.

name: Teck Loon
title: Managing Director at Warburg Pincus LLC
bio: Teck Loon GOH is a Managing Director and Partner in the Warburg Pincus Fundraising and Investor Relations group, based in Singapore. Prior to joining Warburg Pincus in 2020, Teck Loon was the Global Head of Investor Relations at GGV Capital (now Granite Asia and Notable Capital), responsible for all of their LP relationships. Prior to joining GGV Capital in 2016, Teck Loon was a member of the Investment Management Division of Goldman Sachs for 12 years, and a founding member of Goldman Sachs Asset Management’s Asia Private Equity Fund of Funds business in 2006 where he focused on fund investments, secondary transactions and co-investments. Teck Loon graduated from the National University of Singapore in 2004 on the Dean's List and earlier served in the Singapore Armed Forces as an Armour Infantry Combat Medic for 2.5 years.

bio: Investor and family office principal with over 30 years across private equity, venture capital, real estate, and digital infrastructure. More than USD 5 billion in transactional experience spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, with a consistent track record of top-decile returns through market cycles. My work has covered the full spectrum of private markets: primary fund commitments, LP-led and GP-led secondaries, continuation vehicles, control buyouts, growth equity, co-investments, direct investments, and digital infrastructure platforms. Across these mandates, I have partnered with sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices, and global fund managers to deploy capital and unlock liquidity at scale. I view business, conducted with discipline and integrity, as one of the most powerful instruments for positive social change. My vision is to build investment platforms that compound returns for partners while creating durable value for the communities, talent, and ecosystems they touch . ► Areas of Focus • Private Equity Secondaries (LP-led and GP-led continuation vehicles) • Digital Infrastructure and Real Assets • Technology-Enabled Private Equity • Direct Investments and M&A • Board Governance and Investment Committee Leadership

bio: Profissional formada em Comunicação Social com habilitação em Publicidade e Propaganda, com sólida experiência em atendimento ao cliente, suporte comercial, comunicação e marketing digital. Ao longo da minha trajetória, atuei em empresas de comunicação visual, gráfica e serviços financeiros, desenvolvendo habilidades em relacionamento com clientes, elaboração de orçamentos, acompanhamento de processos, organização de demandas, suporte comercial e interface entre equipes. Desde 2019, atuo também com marketing digital e gestão de conteúdo, auxiliando profissionais da saúde no fortalecimento de sua presença online por meio do planejamento, organização e execução de estratégias de comunicação. Minha experiência combina comunicação, organização, atendimento ao cliente, gestão de processos, análise e foco em resultados, permitindo contribuir em áreas como atendimento, suporte comercial, operações administrativas, customer success e marketing.

bio: Hello, bienvenue par ici 🍋 Une petite présentation rapide… 😇 Aujourd'hui, je me consacre à 100 % au coaching Instagram & LinkedIn, ainsi qu'au community management pour les décoratrices et architectes d’intérieur. Avant cela, j’ai passé 25 ans en Nouvelle-Calédonie comme chargée de communication et attachée de presse. Pour le côté « funny », j’ai vécu loin de la Métropole pendant longtemps : 4 ans en Thaïlande, 4 ans au Tchad, 1 an en Amérique Latine, et 30 ans en Nouvelle-Calédonie. Mon arrivée dans la région lyonnaise, il y a 3 ans, a marqué un virage. Toujours dans le domaine de la communication, je me suis spécialisée dans l’accompagnement des décoratrices (quelques messieurs aussi) et architectes d’intérieur sur Instagram et un peu LinkedIn, ces deux réseaux étant essentiels). Pourquoi les décoratrices et les architectes d’intérieur ? Tout simplement parce que je connais bien les défis et les enjeux de ce domaine. C’est un secteur de créativité, d’originalité et d’innovation qui me passionne. Mes précédentes expériences m’ont permis d’écrire pour des magazines spécialisés en décoration et architecture, et pour la petite histoire, j’ai même tenu une boutique de décoration pendant 3 ans. Aujourd’hui je peux t’accompagner de deux manières différentes : + En te rendant autonome sur tes réseaux grâce à un coaching complètement personnalisé + En gérant pour toi tes réseaux : je prends tout en main, je deviens ta community manager ! Jusqu’à présent, mes clients semblent apprécier mon travail ! Leurs témoignages sont disponibles dans la section « recommandations » en bas de mon profil.

bio: Since the age of 14, I have been actively involved in the industry, dedicating myself to learning and improving every day. Since 2013, I have worked full-time for 5 companies and provided freelance services to over 100 different firms. In 2020, I established my own agency to take my professional experience to the next level. I have offered a wide range of services, from social media management and consultancy to e-commerce operations, customer service, and website design. I am particularly skilled at analyzing a company’s core weaknesses and developing solution-oriented strategies to address them. For the past two years, my agency has been providing influencer marketing services, and I have also been managing influencers. I specialize in building strong connections between brands and content creators, developing creative and effective campaigns, and bringing innovative solutions to the industry. In addition, I have been a content creator on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube for the past three years, reaching an audience of over 50,000 followers. This hands-on experience in content creation has given me a deeper understanding of audience engagement and the ever-evolving dynamics of social media platforms. Throughout my education, I have taken specialized training to improve my skills in customer relations and gained expertise in various sectors. With all this knowledge and experience, I continue to make a difference both in my work and through my agency. Key Focus Areas in My Agency: •Influencer Marketing •Influencer Management •Social Media Management and Consultancy •E-commerce Operations Management •Graphic and Web Design •Customer Relations and Strategic Communication My goal is to add value to every company I work with and leave a lasting impact on the industry through innovative and successful projects.

name: Paul Fisher
title: CTO / Co-Founder at Vowel
bio:
Previously, I was a Principal Engineer at Zapier, leading the architecture of AI Agents, after Zapier acquired Vowel (where I was the CTO and Co-Founder).

Vowel, was an AI-powered conferencing platform, which pioneered ground-breaking AI features, such as real-time meeting summarization, action-item detection, and native agentic / search capabilities. 

Vowel was acquired by Zapier in 2023. 

Prior to Vowel, I was the CTO at Recombine, a genomics platform and genetic testing company, which was acquired by Cooper Surgical in 2016 for ~ $100M. After the acquisition of Recombine, I was the CTO at Phosphorus, a genomics company founded as part of the Recombine acquisition.

Prior to Recombine, I was the CTO at Onswipe, a mobile/tablet publishing / adtech platform, which was acquired by Beanstock Media.

I was also the CTO at Sonar Media, a pioneer mobile social discovery platform (which was awarded 2nd place at TechCrunch Disrupt in NYC). Sonar was also one the portfolio companies at K2 MediaLabs — where I served as CTO, prior to joining Sonar.

I was also Director of Engineering at LimeWire, a peer-to-peer file-sharing platform, where I oversaw seven engineering teams internationally. 

Prior to LimeWire I managed technology for Wired Digital, a Conde Nast company, where I lead engineering for wired.com and other Wired brands (including webmonkey.com, hotwired.com, and reddit), in San Francisco and New York.

Prior to Wired, I was the co-founder and CTO of SmartPants Media, an award-winning digital media company, where I developed / launched dozens of interactive and educational software products, including interactive kiosks for the Smithsonian, and telephony/streaming applications deployed across government agencies throughout the US.

I have nearly 30 years of experience building and leading engineering and product teams, with a focus on scaling high-traffic, data-intensive AI / ML platforms. 

Having founded, scaled, and sold several start-ups, I have developed deep business, product, and technical expertise, as well as experience recruiting, launching and marketing products, and scaling cpu and gpu infrastructure to support fault-tolerant, low latency use-cases (leveraging technologies such as terraform, kubernetes, docker, helm, mlops). 

I have co-authored three technology books (published by Apress/Springer) and have authored several patents.

name: Andrew Thomas
bio: I've spent my career building technology that scales — from the first line of code to global platforms handling hundreds of millions of users and transactions daily. Most recently, I co-founded and served as CTO of Intelligent Reach for 13 years, growing it from a startup to a 100-person business operating across the UK, USA, Australia and New Zealand, before a successful exit in 2024. Beyond the CTO role, I also founded and ran the APAC operation as MD — building it from nothing to a profitable team of 10 with enterprise clients including Adidas, Samsung, HP and Lenovo. At its peak, the platform tracked ~600 million unique users, managed ~100 million products across 30,000 data channels daily — all on resilient, auto-scaling cloud infrastructure (Azure & AWS) with a 30TB data warehouse growing 50GB a day. Along the way I raised VC funding, built and led engineering teams to 35 developers, launched into new international markets, and drove 30% of revenue from outside our home market. I'm now selectively exploring my next chapter — founder CTO, technical co-founder, or senior technology leadership roles where I can help scale something genuinely ambitious. Particularly interested in electronics/cloud, smart home/IoT, Space and exciting AI enabled SaaS tech platforms. Core strengths: platform architecture at scale, cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS), building high performing teams, engineering leadership, VC fundraising, and taking products from zero to exit.

name: Felix Serrano
title: Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer at Activus Connect, a Tech Mahindra Company | YPO
bio: With a career defined by transformation, scale, and successful exits, I’ve led from both the boardroom and the ground floor—building high-impact businesses, assembling elite leadership teams, and navigating complex global markets. As the Co-Founder and former CEO of Activus Connect, I scaled a remote-first BPM company from concept to acquisition, leading to a strategic exit to Tech Mahindra. My journey has blended corporate command with entrepreneurial agility. I’ve led $250M+ portfolios, built virtual global workforces, self-funded startups, and driven M&A integrations across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC. I’ve sat on both sides of the table—as the operator and the acquirer—giving me a unique lens on how real, sustainable value is built. Today, I’m on sabbatical. After decades of scaling high-growth ventures, I’ve carved out time to reset, reconnect, and remain curious. But the entrepreneurial fire doesn’t fade—I’m always open to bold conversations and future-focused ventures that aim to do things differently. If you’re building something extraordinary and think I can add value—reach out.

bio: A dynamic, results-oriented tech and business leader with a proven track record of building strong teams, driving sustainable growth, and establishing operational excellence. Served in CEO, President, COO, CFO, CIO roles for publicly traded, PE-backed, and other privately held businesses. I have been brought in to manage roll-ups, return businesses to profitability, and drive rapid growth across several industries from biotech to telecom to media and entertainment and automotive. I have demonstrated success in M&A with over 10 transactions where I have led the due diligence, integration and alignment with each outperforming the investment thesis. I have contributed meaningfully in multiple exits returning more than $1 billion of investor capital. My passion is building corporate competitive advantage and driving growth in tech-based companies and my experience spans sectors focused on SaaS and recurring revenue businesses (B2B and B2C) as well as durable goods, manufacturing, and distribution. Expertise: Recurring Revenue Businesses, Growth Strategy, GTM, Product Strategy, Business Operations, Operational Excellence, Tech, Distribution, Manufacturing, Product Lifecycle Management, Lean, Team Building, M&A, Integrations, Data Science and Business Intelligence, and Investor Relations.

bio:
I am Founder and CEO of Crescendo, a groundbreaking service that blends AI and human expertise to provide exceptional customer service.

A seasoned software executive with deep expertise in scaling high-growth companies. I have a proven track record of running sales, marketing, product, and M&A, having worked for five high-growth companies, three of which went public and two were sold. As the founder of Zendesk's European operation, I helped to establish the company as a global leader in customer service software.

I am passionate about working on interesting projects and helping innovators and founders to scale their visions. As a cross-functional leader, I excel at building consensus and executing tactics through to strategy. I am action-oriented and dedicated to achieving ambitious goals.

Experience:

Senior Vice President at Zendesk Labs, responsible for driving innovation and incubating new businesses and products.

Investor/Board Member/Advisor at Chattermill, Meister, and HappyCo, providing strategic guidance and support to high-growth SaaS companies.

bio:
I live in Portland, Oregon and I have had the great fortune of getting paid to play with computers for almost 20 years. I owned my first computer in 2002, got my first tech job in 2006, launched my first tech product in 2011, and became the co-founder and CEO of my first tech startup in 2017, which was subsequently acquired in 2021. I’ve also spent the last 10+ years building or working for fully-remote companies, so I'm also an advocate for the fully-remote future of work. 

* Serial entrepreneur since age 13
* Distributed systems since ~2008
* A Cloud Native native (cloud infrastructure automation since 2012)
* Open-source software maintainer / open core product proprietor
* Dabbler in thought leadership (Open Core & everything as code)
* Passionate community builder (2x tech conference Founder)
* Product manager by day, developer advocate at heart
* Let's #makethings together!

title: Co-Founder | Co-CEO at Lexos - We are Hiring
bio: Tech Founder | SaaS Exit → TOTVS (B3) | SaaS Scale-up & E-Commerce I build at the intersection of product, technology, and capital. From zero to exit and from exit to what's next. Lexos (2009 → TOTVS 2023) — Founded and scaled a SaaS platform that centralized marketplace and e-commerce operations for Brazilian retailers — 2,000+ active clients, ~R$2B in annual GMV, acquired by TOTVS (B3: TOTS3) in 2023. Full GTM cycles, enterprise sales, and ecosystem partnerships with Brazil's largest marketplaces: Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magazine Luiza and TikTok Shop. Officially homologated by all five platforms — including partner recognition awards (Amazon Conecta). Inside TOTVS (2023–2025) — Stayed on as Statutory Director. Led a 100+ person team across product, engineering, sales, and CS. Built nationwide commercial expansion across regional offices, trained sales teams, and managed C-level partnerships across Brazil's digital ecosystem. Post-exit — Advisor and angel investor working directly with founders on GTM strategy, governance, fundraising, and liquidity events. Embedded in the Brazilian tech and VC ecosystem. Regular columnist at E-Commerce Brasil and speaker at RD Summit 2025. Donnah AI — Building a post-meeting execution platform. Decisions made in meetings actually happen, turning conversations into action through AI, WhatsApp and CRM integrations My edge: I've sat on both sides of the table — as the founder being backed and as the executive scaling inside a public company. I understand what it takes to grow from zero and what it takes to operate at scale. Marathon runner. Ironman triathlete. High performance is a lifestyle, not a campaign.
