bio: Many founder-led companies reach a point where growth begins to feel harder than it should. Revenue increases. The team grows. The opportunity remains. Yet decisions slow, leadership waits for direction, and the organization becomes more not less dependent on the founder. This is rarely a motivation problem. It is an architecture problem. Enterprise value is not an outcome. It is designed. Most founder-led companies don’t stall because of markets. They stall because the business eventually outgrows the founder operating model. Revenue scales. Complexity multiplies. Yet leadership systems, decision flow, operational structure, governance, and capital alignment often remain founder-dependent, quietly compressing growth, execution, and enterprise value. That’s the work I’ve spent the last 30 years inside. I work with founder-led companies, ownership groups, and investors when growth begins to outpace the existing operating model, helping redesign the leadership and operational architecture required to scale, attract capital, increase enterprise value, and operate beyond founder dependency. The work integrates: • strategy • leadership systems • AI leverage • execution discipline • governance • capital alignment into one scalable enterprise architecture. Over three decades across industrial automation, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, energy and professional services, I’ve contributed to more than $2B in M&A transactions and worked alongside 150+ leadership teams across Canada and the United States. Most buyers don’t buy businesses. They buy leadership systems. Donald (Don) Haché Founder of Selltron Group and 10X Strategy. Knowledge is now abundant. Time is scarce. 📅 tidycal.com/donhache

name: Mat Ball
title: Director of Product Marketing
bio:
I’m a product marketing executive with a track record of building go-to-market strategy that drives real business growth—across new market entry, global sales enablement, and strategic positioning. My background spans leadership roles at Conviva, Splunk, and New Relic, where I’ve helped scale PMM functions, craft differentiated narratives, and launch category-defining products.

At Conviva, I lead product marketing for new markets—a critical growth area for the company. I built the GTM function from the ground up, including messaging, demand generation, competitive strategy, and global team development. That work helped us break into new verticals, land key logos, and establish a repeatable motion that now drives significant pipeline for the business.

Previously at Splunk, I led go-to-market strategy for core Observability products, shaping global sales motions, launching major initiatives, and partnering across product, marketing, and field to improve engagement and adoption at scale. I also played a key role in market perception shifts through analyst relations, keynote strategy, and positioning work.

I bring a proven ability to scale GTM strategy, build high-performing teams, and drive business impact—especially in fast-moving, cross-functional environments.

name: Aisha Shaikh
title: Product Marketing Manager | M.A. Public Management
location: San Francisco Bay Area United States
bio:
As a senior product marketing manager at Enact, I lead the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for innovative solutions in SaaS, consumer tech, and software. With over 8 years of experience in product marketing, I have a proven track record of driving customer acquisition, retention, and growth for B2B and B2C clients across various industries and markets.

Core Competencies:
Go-to-Market Strategy: Expertise in crafting and executing comprehensive go-to-market plans that align product positioning with market needs, driving successful product launches and market penetration.

Market Research & Analysis: Proficient in conducting in-depth market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities, customer insights, and trends, ensuring data-driven decisions for product development and marketing strategies.

Product Positioning & Messaging: Skilled in developing clear, compelling, and differentiated product positioning and messaging frameworks that resonate with target audiences and enhance brand visibility.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Adept at leading and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management, sales, and engineering, to ensure alignment and successful execution of marketing strategies.

Digital Marketing: Proficient in SEO, SEM, PPC, email marketing, and social media campaigns, leveraging digital channels to maximize customer engagement and acquisition.

Customer Segmentation & Persona Development: Experienced in defining and refining customer segments and personas, tailoring marketing strategies to meet the unique needs and preferences of different audience groups.

Performance Analytics: Strong ability to analyze marketing performance metrics, optimize campaigns, and report on KPIs, ensuring continuous improvement and ROI maximization.

Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders, fostering collaboration and achieving business objectives.

title: Empowering the Future with AI: A Passionate Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Specialist Driving Innovation!
bio: Hello, I'm Clarence, a seasoned Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Specialist. With over 15 years of extensive experience in the field, I've dedicated my career to pushing the boundaries of AI and ML technologies. As a former AI/ML Research Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer, I have honed a diverse set of skills and an innovative mindset. My journey in this dynamic industry has been marked by a series of pioneering projects and collaborations that have not only advanced the field but also provided practical solutions to complex problems. Skills & Expertise: 🧠 Deep Learning & Neural Networks: Expertise in crafting and refining neural networks that mimic the human brain, leading to groundbreaking advancements in AI. 🤖 Machine Learning Algorithms: Proficient in developing sophisticated algorithms that enable machines to learn from data, providing smarter, more efficient solutions. 📊 Data Analysis & Big Data: Skilled in dissecting large datasets to extract meaningful insights, driving data-driven decision-making processes. 💻 Programming Proficiency: Strong background in programming languages like Python, R, and Java, vital for creating and implementing complex AI models. 📈 Predictive Modeling & Analytics: Expert in developing models that forecast future trends, enhancing strategic planning and operational efficiency. 🌐 Cloud Computing & AI Integration: Experienced in leveraging cloud technologies for scalable AI solutions, optimizing computing resources and data management. 🔍 Research & Development: A solid track record in R&D, contributing to the scientific community with published papers and innovative research findings. 👥 Cross-functional Collaboration: Adept at working across various teams, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and knowledge sharing. 📢 Communication & Leadership: Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to diverse audiences and lead teams towards common goals. 🧮 Ethical AI & Responsible Innovation: Committed to developing AI solutions that are ethical, transparent, and contribute positively to society.

bio: I am an aspiring Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning researcher with a strong academic background and practical experience in designing, implementing, and optimizing intelligent systems. Over the years, I have cultivated a deep passion for advancing the boundaries of AI, particularly in the areas of large language models (LLMs), fine-tuning strategies, and agentic frameworks. My career journey reflects a balance of rigorous academic training, hands-on research, and applied problem-solving across diverse projects, each of which has strengthened my ability to contribute to cutting-edge innovation in this rapidly evolving field. My educational foundation was built at the National Institute of Technology, Trichy — India, where I earned my Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. This experience was not only academically rigorous but also instrumental in developing my analytical mindset and problem-solving orientation. During my undergraduate years, I engaged with core concepts in computer science and mathematics, sharpening my ability to translate theoretical knowledge into practical applications. This period also laid the groundwork for my interest in machine learning, data-driven decision-making, and the transformative potential of AI technologies. Building upon this solid foundation, I pursued my Master’s degree in Computer Science (AI/ML focus), which provided me with advanced exposure to machine learning models, natural language processing, deep learning, and applied AI systems. Through coursework, research, and projects, I gained proficiency in designing algorithms, optimizing models, and leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. My academic pursuits were complemented by practical experiences in developing end-to-end machine learning pipelines, exploring model interpretability, and contributing to projects that combined technical sophistication with real-world relevance.

Passionate about programming languages, compilers, and developer tooling. Strength in leading projects, driving technical innovation, and delivering scalable solutions. Strong skill in problem-solving, decision-making, and critical thinking. Experience includes: Implementing continuous integration (CI) and continuous deployment (CD) using Jenkins, Github Action, along with GitHub, and other version control tools. Performing Unit Testing, Integration Testing and End to End testing by using Jest, Mocha, Cypress. Deploying SAAS application infrastructure in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Optimizing build pipelines for JavaScript, CSS, and assets using Webpack, Vite with hands-on experience in code splitting, tree-shaking, and lazy loading. Configuring task runners like Grunt and Gulp to automate repetitive tasks such as file minification, SASS/LESS compilation, and live reloading during development. Performing data mutation and query with REST API and GraphQL API. Web application Accessibility Design and Responsive Design. TECHNICAL SKILLS: Languages: HTML/5, CSS/3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, PHP. Technologies: React, Next.js, Angular, Tailwind CSS, Sass/Less, Bootstrap, Jest, Cypress, storybook, GraphQL, TanStack Query, Babel, Webpack, Vite, Gulp, npm. title: Experienced Software Engineer | React.js Frontend Specialist | 5+ Years Building Scalable Web Applications | TypeScript • JavaScript • Spring Boot • AWS | ex-Baker Hughes
bio: I build web applications that perform at scale without sacrificing user experience. Over the past 6 years, I've specialized in frontend architecture and full-stack engineering — creating systems that are fast, maintainable, and built to evolve with growing teams and products. My technical focus centers on modern React ecosystems: TypeScript, Next.js, and component-driven development with Storybook. I optimize for performance through strategic code-splitting, lazy loading, and Core Web Vitals tuning, while maintaining clean architecture using React Query and Zustand. On the backend, I work with Node.js and Spring Boot APIs, building scalable, containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines that enable teams to ship confidently. At Baker Hughes, I led a cross-functional team building a real-time oil-well monitoring platform that unified live telemetry with historical data. The result: improved operational visibility across hundreds of wells and measurably higher customer retention. I recently completed my M.S. in Information Systems at Northeastern University, deepening my expertise in distributed systems and cloud architecture. I'm currently seeking senior frontend or full-stack engineering roles where I can contribute to performance-critical applications and help teams scale their architecture. If you're building something ambitious, or want to discuss frontend performance, system design, or scalable architectures — let's connect.

Throughout my career, I have built strong communication skills and the ability to work well with clients and colleagues, always focusing on teamwork and organization.

name: Sìlvia Ferreira
title: Ortoptista - Well's Óptica
bio: Sou licenciada em Ortoptica pela ESSEM desde 2006. Exerço a minha profissão desde Dezembro de 2006, onde comecei por realizar rastreios oftalmológicos de medicina do trabalho na clinica Unimed, no Campo Grande. Em Maio de 2007 fui transferida para a clínica BH Saldanha (antiga Microcular) onde exerci em pleno as funções de Ortoptista, assim como, planos pré-cirúrgicos de Lasik e contactologia de lentes hidrófilas, semi-rigidas e híbridas. Também já fiz vendas de balcão numa óptica, assim como consultas de optometria, desde Maio de 2008 até Abril de 2012. Atualmente exerço funções no grupo Sonae, mais concretamente nas ópticas Well's, ondo procedo à realização de consultas de optometria, contactologia e ortóptica.

bio: I am a highly experienced football professional with more than 30 years in the game, spanning coaching, scouting, recruitment, performance analysis, and data-driven strategy. My work sits at the intersection of football expertise and innovation, helping clubs build a clear competitive identity through elite analysis, recruitment intelligence, and tailored performance solutions. As a UEFA A Licence coach, I have worked across multiple levels of the game, from youth development environments to national team settings. That breadth of experience allows me to connect tactical understanding, player development, squad construction, and recruitment strategy into one aligned football model. I specialize in data visualization, performance analysis, opposition analysis, scouting, and recruitment support. I have built and implemented customized analytical frameworks that support both technical staff and recruitment departments, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that improve decision-making, enhance team performance, and strengthen player evaluation processes. My expertise includes the design of bespoke reporting, positional and team-level performance frameworks, individual development support, and integrated workflows that combine video, data, and scouting intelligence. I am particularly focused on turning large volumes of football data into practical outputs for coaches, analysts, sporting directors, and executive leadership. I am proficient across a wide range of industry-leading platforms and technologies, including Hudl Suite, Sportscode, Hudl Studio, StatsBomb, Opta, SkillCorner, Wyscout, Tactic Pro, Coach Paint, Tableau, PowerPoint, Excel, Fulcrum, Spiideo, Nacsport, and Catapult MatchTracker, among others. Throughout my career, I have collaborated with organizations across different countries and performance levels, building strong relationships and a reputation for delivering high-level insight, professionalism, and forward-thinking analytical support. Whether supporting recruitment strategy, opposition preparation, player development, or broader football operations, I bring a modern, detail-driven, and practical approach to helping clubs gain an edge.

bio: Experienced professional in Scouting, Data Analysis and Sports Science, focused on optimizing processes in identifying and recruiting athletes for high-performance football. My career includes leadership positions as Lead Scout in Brazil for Orlando City SC and Everton FC, where I was responsible for mapping, analyzing and recommending talents with potential for global elite leagues, extensively using tools such as Wyscout, Hudl, InStat, OptaPro, ProVision, Scout7 ISF, Scoutastic, Tableu, SQL, Python. With two degrees in Sports Science and specializations in data analysis, I work at the intersection between the field and the laboratory, translating numbers into effective strategies. My passion is discovering and developing talent, applying an analytical and scientific approach to assess not only technical and tactical skills, but also the physical and mental aspects that define an exceptional player. I have a successful track record in building strategic contact networks and delivering detailed reports that support critical investment decisions in players. I seek positions where I can leverage my expertise in market intelligence, performance analysis and international scouting to build winning teams and drive the success of clubs with global ambition, committed to excellence and continuous innovation in football science in order to apply my knowledge in challenging environments, contributing to the development of athletes and teams through insights based on applied football science aligned with data.

name: Stefano Baralla
title: Video Consultant at Brentford FC/ Data Football Analyst at Smartodds
bio: I am very fond of football - I started playing football at the age of 5 years and at 18 years old I decided to stop playing football and I started working to earn some money ; so I worked 2 years as shop assistant and meanwhile I decided to stop playing football as it was likely impossible to finish working at 7.30pm and training at 8pm after a long work day (2009) In 2011 I was a crazy 20 years old and I went to Pisa to make a 1 month trial (mini-naja) and I enjoyed a lot and everybody wanted me to become a soldier in Pisa but I did not want to. In 2012 I decided to work for Wyscout - an Italian company that supports football scouting and in 2014/2015 I played football again conquering a Promotion in amateur football. After promotion I decided to give up with football again as I did not feel confident with that team and coach as well and I had to work. In 2017/2018 I played again with another team and we conquered a Cup in Coppa Liguria but at the end of the year I decided again to give up with football as my goal was moving to UK as I did in February 2019. I moved to London in February 2019 and I was immediately able to find a new job two months later (April 2019) as I started to work for Smartodds - a company which provides statistical research and consulting services about sports - as Football Watcher and since July 2019 as Consultant Analyst as well. Meanwhile In January 2020 Tina Keech - former Head of Research & Analysis at Smartodds - gave me the great opportunity to meet Chris Bradley - Brentford FC Scouting Coordinator - and I started a part-time role as Video Recruitment Consultant as well. In November 2020 I started a collaboration with NLP Sports as Entry Level Scout as well. For more info please contact: stebaralla@hotmail.it

name: Joe Jermy
title: Tournament Football Analyst with FIFA
bio: I'm a Football Performance Analyst with real-world experience at both professional club and international level, currently in my third year studying Performance Analysis and Coaching Science at the University of Derby. Right now I'm embedded within the setup at Nottingham Forest Women as part of my university placement, where I'm involved across the full weekly cycle, from pitch-side filming and session coding through to delivering data-led reports and presentations that feed directly into coaching decisions. It's an environment that's pushed me to work quickly, communicate clearly, and make sure the analysis I produce actually lands with the people who need it. Alongside that, I've been working with FIFA as a freelance analyst on some of the biggest tournaments in the world. Coding elite fixtures at that level, across multiple competitions and tight schedules, has given me a discipline and attention to detail that I bring into everything I do. I'm confident across a range of tools including: Hudl Sportscode, StatsBomb, Wyscout, Angles and PowerBI, but what I care about most is making analysis useful. Whether that's a tactical report, a recruitment clip, or a set-play video, the goal is always the same: give coaches and players the right information, at the right time, in a format they can act on.

bio: 📊 Football Performance Analyst | Scout Passionate about the analysis and tactical side of football, I have built a career in performance analysis, scouting, and coaching with clubs like Tottenham Hotspur, Stockport County, and Charlton Athletic. My journey has been driven by a deep love for the game and a commitment to using data, video analysis, and scouting to enhance player and team performance. With a Bachelor’s degree in Football Studies from the University of Bedfordshire, I’ve gained both the academic foundation and hands-on experience needed to thrive in elite football environments. From breaking down match footage to identifying future stars, I specialise in delivering insightful, data-driven analysis that supports coaching decisions and player development. 🔑 Key Skills: ⚽ Performance Analysis (Hudl, SportsCode, Wyscout) 📊 Match & Data Analysis (Tableau,In-Play Software) 🎥 Filming & Video Editing (Match Coding, Post-Match Review) 🔎 Scouting & Talent Identification 🤝 Strong Communication & Collaboration I thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced football environments, ensuring that coaches, analysts, and decision-makers have the insights they need to succeed. Whether it’s breaking down tactical patterns, assessing player performances, or scouting emerging talent, I bring a meticulous and detail-oriented approach to everything I do.

name: Rubén Martín
title: Head Coach - Professional Tactical Analyst - Analista Táctico Profesional - Individual Player Development Coach - Match Analyst - UEFA A Coach
bio: Soy analista de fútbol profesional de rendimiento con amplia experiencia en diferentes niveles competitivos del fútbol, incluyendo Segunda RFEF, Copa del Rey, Tercera RFEF y Juvenil DH de España. Especialista en fundamentos tanto individuales como colectivos junto con análisis del juego. También me he desempeñado como entrenador con una experiencia de más de 10 años, cuento con licencia UEFA A. Me considero un amante del juego y de desmenuzarlo al completo. Metódico, apasionado del trabajo y con hambre de crecimiento constante y aprendizaje. He desempeñado funciones como analista de rivales en los que he generado informes tanto de juego, de datos, individuales como de acciones a balón parado. A nivel de partido realizo análisis en directo generando informe tanto al descanso del partido como al finalizarlo relacionado con el análisis propio. En cuanto a análisis propio he realizado funciones de análisis post partido con la búsqueda de mejora basado en el modelo de juego para servir de apoyo a los entrenadores con los que he compartido cometido. A nivel de análisis individual he tutorizado a jugadores en los que semanalmente les hago informe exhaustivo en base a su partido junto con un informe detallado con todos los datos proporcionados. Por otro lado he trabajado en canteras realizando scouting de jugadores tanto formativo como semiprofesional como profesional. A lo largo de mi carrera, he trabajado con equipos de diversas categorías, contribuyendo al desarrollo de jugadores jóvenes y ayudando a los entrenadores a tomar decisiones fundamentadas en datos objetivos y análisis exhaustivos. Mi objetivo es seguir contribuyendo al éxito de equipos a través de un análisis preciso, identificando y potenciando el talento. Dominio de software como de análisis Nacsport, Oncesport, Bepro11, Eric, Wyscout, Metrica, Livetag Pro, etc. Habilidades avanzadas en edición de video, ofimatica completa, y Powerbi.

Also experienced across a variety of performance analysis software including Sportscode, HUDL Studio, Metrica sports, and SBG Focus through work across the men’s, women’s and academy game. I have worked in a huge variety of environments whether it be part time, full time or college athletes. As a result I have become very adaptable in delivering analysis through a number of different workflows, game models and departments.

name: Aaron Barnes
title: First Team Scout @ Stoke City
bio: I'm a First Team Scout and Recruitment Analyst with 4+ years of experience working at Championship and EFL level, currently with Stoke City FC and previously Charlton Athletic FC. My background is rooted in football — I came through the Arsenal Academy, played professionally for Charlton Athletic, Torquay United, and Colchester United, and continue to play semi-professionally. That lived experience gives me a unique perspective most analysts: I understand what it takes to perform at the highest level, not just what the data says. In my scouting roles I've been responsible for the full talent identification process — attending live matches, analysing video and statistical data across platforms including StatsBomb, Wyscout, Hudl, Opta, InStat, and Transfer Room, building shortlists, and presenting player recommendations directly to Directors of Football, Managers, and Club Owners. Beyond the core scouting work, I helped build a bespoke scout report system at Charlton, coordinated fixture scheduling across the scouting team, and managed my current role entirely remotely — so I'm as comfortable working independently as I am as part of a wider department. I hold a First Class BA (Hons) in Sports Management from the University of Kent and am actively developing my skills in data analysis. Concurrently, as an Academy Coach at Pro Soccer Academy, I apply my knowledge to nurture upcoming talent, focusing on skill development and tactical awareness. My mission is to drive excellence on and off the pitch, fostering an environment where athletes can thrive through strategic insight and a passion for football. I'm passionate about football intelligence and recruitment, and I'm open to conversations about opportunities in sports technology, data and analysis, sales, or specialist recruitment — particularly where my football background and industry network can add genuine value.

name: Pat Murphy
title: Senior iOS Developer at iCueMotion
bio:
I have 15+ years of iOS full time software experience and have been doing iOS development since 2009, I'm an expert professional in Swift, SwiftUI, and Objective-C along with Xcode, and have done mixed language Apps. The advantages of building a new App in SwiftUI are substantial! SwiftUI Apps are less code than UIKit and, easier to maintain, no storyboard, no auto layout constraints or anchor constraints, and you can visually prototype new views in just minutes. SwiftUI is very stable and there is absolutely no reason not to use it. I have my own consulting company, Fitamatic LLC with my own Federal EIN for tax purposes so you can deal with me directly for consulting purposes. I'm very good at architecting new iOS Apps that are easy to maintain and are high performance. I can use SwiftData, CoreData or for very data intensive Apps high performance SQLite. I use a DataAccess class written in Swift with consumes Codable models that decode the Servers RestFul API JSON in just one line of code, and then write all of this data directly into SQLite using high performance SQL transactions. The DataAccess class can also do Upsert's which are high performance inserts or updates. I use Alamofire for the networking RestFul API's. I can create a new SwiftUI View with the Server API call and Codable model to populate the view in just 30 minutes for a simple view. These views are easy to understand and maintain and are very high performance.
 I'm also very good with Bluetooth having done firmware on a Nordic nRF52833 using Segger Embedded Studio and JLink for real time debug. I've interfaced iOS Apps to Bluetooth Sensors with reliable Swift code that automatically reconnects the Sensor if it goes out of range and comes back in.
I'm very good at working with JIRA to close out bugs or implement new features, and know how to create Pull Requests in GitHub and merge and update these properly. SwiftUI uses Environment Objects to access your View Models, and this makes these objects global and easy to access plus they maintain the State of the view and UI. 
 I also know Go-Lang with the Gin framework for creating RestFul Services for an App to consume. Go-Lang Servers are much easier to maintain and are higher performance over PHP, Node.js, Python or JavaScript and support concurrency making it ideal for RestFul Servers. I know the Go-Land IDE for debugging and developing Go-Lang.
 I also know Android using Jet Pack Compose (JPC) using the Intellij IDEA environment. JPC is somewhat similar to SwiftUI, both are declarative to define the Apps UI and are very intuitive.

bio: Hey there! 👋 Computer Science & Engineering grad with a love for code. Got my Bachelor's and Master's from L.C Institute of Tech and Ganpat University. Geeky about Object-Oriented Analysis and Mobile App Design. Jumped into iOS dev in 2018, always up for a tech adventure! 💻 Committed, positive, and ready to conquer the dev world. Passionate and results-driven iOS Developer with 7+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying high-quality iOS applications, including 4 published apps on the App Store. Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and Apple's ecosystem, with strong command over Xcode, Auto Layout, Core Data, Core Location, Combine, AVFoundation, Vision Framework, CoreBluetooth, and Redis. Skilled in consuming RESTful APIs using JSON, integrating back-end systems through Firebase, AWS, and Azure, and implementing secure authentication flows with OAuth 2.0. Experienced with multithreading techniques using GCD and Operation Queues, performance tuning with Instruments, and following Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices using XCTest and TestFlight. Strong knowledge of architectural patterns like MVC and MVVM, as well as design patterns including Abstract Factory, Builder, and Communication. Familiar with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and performing peer code reviews, mentoring juniors, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Focused on delivering clean, maintainable code with strong attention to performance, memory management, and Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) for best-in-class mobile experiences.

name: Romy Ilano
title: Senior iOS Developer
bio:
I’m an iOS Mobile Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience programming iOS in Objective-C and Swift who has cut my teeth in multiple start-ups in Silicon Valley as well as large companies. 

I’m the engineer willing to go out and take screenshots of all the competitors’ products and disseminate them technically with the team, write up swagger documentation to avoid death by unversioned Microsoft Word documents, diagram sequence flows and UML in mermaid markdown to avoid confusion even when none of these roles is “my job”. 

Outside of work I’m involved in tech meetups in the community (minimum 10-20 hours per week) because you cannot learn everything at work and your work cannot teach you everything you need to learn! Change is not optional in these times

Skills & Qualifications
• Start-up veteran familiar with the necessary resiliency, tough conversations and faith needed to conquer the unknown.
• 10 + years of strong development experience in Objective-C and Swift languages across diverse applications including bluetooth head units in cars at Mercedes Benz and bluetooth on AppleWatch
• 3 1/2 years advanced SwiftUI experience full time at my last position at Ontada on an all-SwiftUI app 
• Client/Server interaction via REST for various enterprise applications in healthcare, messaging, and more.
• Versed in major iOS frameworks including the latest SwiftUI, UIKit workarounds, HealthKit, ResearchKit, PDFKit, VisionKit, RealityKit, ARKit, and more.

Languages: English (native), German (fluent)

bio:
9+ years of experience in iOS development with Objective C and Swift, analysis, design, development, implementation and testing.
Experience using Swift to develop and support iOS apps.
Experience in Swift using advanced technologies and algorithms, using blocks with NSOperation or GCD for asynchronous calls and managing queues, use of generics, test driven development, connecting real-time with socket.io.
Experience in iOS development using iOS SDK from 8 to 14 (Cocoa Touch, View Controller, Location, Push Notifications, Local storage, Blocks/Closures, Auto layout, asynchronous RESTful JSON connections, Objective-C and Swift.
Experience in developing 5 Apps.

Experience creating adaptable UI with Auto Layout and with UIKIT.
Experience with Sprite Kit and Scene Kit libraries.

name: Bruno Barão
title: Strength & Conditioning Coach - Sporting CP Modalities
bio: I am a dedicated and passionate professional in the area of strength and conditioning. Throughout my career, I had the opportunity to develop skills such as planning and prescribing a sports season, as well as its evaluation and monitoring. I really believe that the goal of training isn't the exercise, or the method, the goal is the stimulus and therefore the adaptation. And I believe that collaboration and interdisciplinary work are essential to achieve ambitious goals. My focus is on helping athletes reach their maximum, creating routines and a training culture that offers greater knowledge of training and its benefits. I am always looking for new challenges that allow me to grow, learn and contribute to the success of institutions that share my vision of professionalism, passion and excellence.

name: Caetano Cardoso
title: Strength and Conditioning Coach
bio: Hi there! My name is Caetano and I'm a (work in process) Strength and Condition coach from Lisbon, Portugal. With a positive mindset and open critical sense, my workflow focuses on working with athletes enhancing their performance, preventing injuries and improving strength, speed, and power. I graduated in 2024 with my bachelor's degree in Physical Education and Sport from Lusófona University and I have a 1st degree Judo Coach as well as a Running & Trail certification. I easily get enthusiastic about the bond that we can create between the body and the mind. I've started teaching Judo in 2016 in different schools until the Pandemic, COVID-19. In 2023 I started an 8 month internship in Sporting Clube de Portugal with the triathlon team, where I've focused on enhancing the performance of young athletes between 14 and 21yrs old focused on conditioning and performance. Let's Talk! ⚡️

bio: I hold a degree in Physical Education from the Federal University of Bahia (UFBA) in Brazil, as well as Postgraduate studies in Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation. To further enhance my expertise, I am currently pursuing a Master's degree in Sports Science (High Performance) at the University of Porto (FADEUP) in Portugal. During my time in Ireland, I had the opportunity to immerse myself in a new culture and language while honing my English skills. This experience broadened my perspective and allowed me to see the world from a different angle. Since 2009, I have been working as a Physical Trainer, specializing in strength and conditioning as well as return to play protocols for various sports such as football, athletics, cycling, tennis, surfing, and martial arts. My passion for helping individuals achieve their athletic potential led me to establish my own sports consulting company in 2021, called +Plus Sports Performance. Through +Plus Sports Performance, I have quickly gained recognition as one of the region's leading providers of sports performance training. Recognizing the growing demand for enhanced performance in specific disciplines, I focused on catering to individuals seeking to improve their sporting abilities. Moreover, I discovered an opportunity to extend my expertise in high-performance sports to the corporate sector in Portugal. By prioritizing the health and well-being of employees, I have been able to contribute to the overall productivity and success of companies. With my extensive international experience and diverse background, I am confident in my ability to help individuals achieve their goals.
